mistake.en: Saying open the light instead of turn on the light
mistake.l1: Chinese kāi dēng uses the verb open (kāi) for lights.

segments.text: Don't say, please open the light. Say, please turn on the light.
In Chinese, we open the light. In English, we turn it on.
Repeat after me. Please turn on the light. Please turn off the fan.
Great job! Open is for doors.

native.caption: 中文说“开灯”，所以很多人直接说成“open the light”。其实英语要说“turn on the light”，关灯是“turn off the light”。跟着 Ama 老师读一读，在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多语法。

en.caption: In Chinese you say “open the light”, so many people say it in English too. In English you say “turn on the light”, and to switch it off, “turn off the light”. Read along with teacher Ama and practice more grammar in the Lexkite app.
